For future reference, I used the [http://diberri.dyndns.org/html2wiki.html HTML tables to wiki converter] listed at [[m:Help:table]] and:
<pre>sed -r 's/([[:alpha:]]+-[[:digit:]]+)/<cite id="\1" style="font-style:normal;">\1<\/cite>/
s/( *class="[^d].*)\| *([[:digit:]]+)/\1| {{teotw|\2}}/
s/}}-([[:digit:]]+)/}} - {{teotw|\1}}/'</pre>
--[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 20:16, 22 Nov 2005 (UTC)

==GFDL or not?==

So if this is inserted by permission, are we allowed to edit it? I don't see how it can be here and '''not''' be GFDL, but maybe I missed something. We should have linked to it if that's the case... [[User:Nae'blis|nae'blis]] ''<sub>[[User_talk:Nae'blis|(talk)]]</sub>'' 04:00, 28 Dec 2005 (UTC)

: Any particular changes made by us will be GFDL, but Steven's original summaries and whichever parts may have been quoted directly from the books are not GFDL.  I do not forsee any problems, but if there ever were one we can revert to the old version which does not include the summary column. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 05:06, 28 Dec 2005 (UTC)

==Major Update==
Hello all. I wanted to quantify the changes I made to the page. Table was re-worked for ease of edit-ability in the future and links were added. Days that did not have any events were removed except for the ones that had the lunar picture in them. The reaseon I did this was to shorted the table, empty days, in my opinion, did not need to be there. Also, I left the lunar changes to show the passage of time. I also changed the color. Some of the links would have been hard to find with the blue background. Please let me know if there are any more suggestions.
